brand.name: AI Comic Translator
meta.title: AI Comic Translator — whole-issue comic translation
meta.description: Translate an entire comic issue in one pass with consistent names, glossary, and lettering. Upload pages, download a finished ZIP.
landing.title: AI Comic Translator — translate a whole issue at once
landing.lead: We translate the whole issue in one pass — with a shared glossary and character voice. Names and speech stay consistent page to page: the model sees the comic as a whole.
landing.hero_alt: Comic before and after translation: Japanese text and English lettering
landing.hero_caption: Before and after: source balloons cleaned and re-lettered in your target language.
landing.register_lead: Sign in with Google or Apple and upload your issue pages — the source language is detected automatically.
landing.diff_title: The whole issue, not a single page
landing.diff_lead: Typical tools process panel by panel. We keep issue-wide context: glossary and speech style stay shared across the whole job.
landing.diff1_body: Balloons, SFX, and captions are read with the panel — not as bare OCR text.
landing.diff2_body: Names, places, and character speech stay stable across every page.
landing.diff3_body: Text goes back into cleaned balloons — finished pages download as a ZIP.
landing.how_lead: From page upload to a ZIP of finished pages — one flow.
landing.step1_body: Issue pages or a ZIP of jpg, png, webp.
landing.step2_body: Source language is detected from the text; you choose the target language.
landing.step3_body: Balloons, cleanup, and translation of the whole issue with shared context.
landing.step4_body: Finished pages as a ZIP for offline reading.
landing.closing_user_lead: Upload issue pages and run a full translation.
landing.closing_guest_lead: Sign in with Google or Apple above — source language is picked up automatically.
landing.compare_lead: Services like MangaGloss translate one page at a time. We keep shared context across the entire issue.
landing.compare_us1: Whole issue in one job — shared glossary
landing.compare_us2: Character names stay stable page to page
landing.compare_us3: Text placed back into cleaned balloons
landing.compare_page3: Often plain text or manual paste
landing.compare_us4: Upload all pages → one ZIP download
landing.faq1_a: Upload JPG, PNG, WebP, or GIF images — or a ZIP of them. Each file becomes one page.
landing.faq2_a: There is no hard cap in the app, but very large issues take longer. We warn you when you select 50+ files at once.
landing.faq3_a: The model sees text from the whole issue (or large batches) in one translation pass, so glossary and speech style stay shared.
landing.faq4_q: Do I need to pick the source language?
landing.faq4_a: No — it is detected automatically from the text on your pages.
landing.faq5_q: What do I download when it's done?
landing.faq5_a: Finished pages as a ZIP, plus an optional translations.json with the extracted and translated text.
landing.faq6_q: How long are my files kept?
landing.faq6_a: Projects are auto-deleted after {days} days of inactivity on the server. Download your ZIP before then.
landing.faq7_a: No — extract and render run on the server CPU. You only need a browser to upload and download.
landing.privacy_lead: Uploaded pages and translations are stored only for your project. They are automatically deleted after {days} days unless you remove the project sooner.
